decision_source.intent: Reconcile the two selected source epochs through their owners, rerun Goals validation, and open G-D65-DEFINITIONS only if D65-P0 closes.

The product-thesis package validates with status PASS after its definitions dependency was synchronized to the selected clean source epoch.

goals_package.interpretation: The selected Project, Goal, definitions, and thesis dependencies have no validation error. Ambient errors remain diagnostic under the ontology-runtime enforcement suspension and grant no package-wide admission.

non_effects: This decision does not change canonical definition or Product Thesis meaning.
This decision does not grant package-wide Goals admission or resolve unrelated Craft, Define, Governance, or Product Ontology errors.

This decision does not admit an integration definition set, Product Capability, business ontology, DomainSpec source, system ontology, ConstructionBinding, implementation, conformance result, migration, cutover, publication, release, deployment, or external effect.
claim_ceiling: Selected source-epoch reconciliation and D65-P0 dependency closure for this exact Goal only. G-D65-DEFINITIONS remains a separate owner gate.
